themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their advocacy for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to social benefits, housing, and public services. This theme has gained traction in Spain, Italy, and France, with parties like Vox, Lega, and Rassemblement National framing it as a defense of national sovereignty and cultural identity.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in social aid and housing, criticizing PP for delays in negotiations.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini and Lega push for stricter immigration controls and citizenship revocation for crimes.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Opposes EU migration policies and advocates for national preference in welfare.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Proposes laws to restrict social benefits for non-citizens and prioritize Polish nationals.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Calls for stricter immigration controls and prioritization of British citizens in public services.

themes.title: Trump’s policies dominate global right-wing coverage
themes.blurb: Donald Trump's domestic and foreign policies continue to shape right-wing discourse worldwide, with his administration's decisions—such as troop deployments, sanctions, and deregulation—echoing in the rhetoric of allied parties in Poland, Argentina, and the UK. His influence extends to electoral strategies and policy debates in these countries.

themes.title: Rise of far-right parties in European polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Germany, Sweden, France, and Norway are gaining significant traction in recent polls, reflecting growing voter dissatisfaction with mainstream parties. This trend is reshaping political landscapes, with parties like AfD, Sverigedemokraterna, and Rassemblement National positioning themselves as viable alternatives.

countries.note: Leads French polls for the 2027 presidential election, focusing on migration and sovereignty.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Poland, Hungary, Argentina, and Italy are grappling with internal divisions, as factions clash over leadership, policy direction, and alliances. These conflicts threaten party cohesion and electoral prospects, with figures like Orbán, Milei, and Salvini facing challenges from within their own ranks.

themes.title: Far-right governments target universities and education
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right governments in Hungary, the U.S., Argentina, and Germany are implementing policies to reshape higher education, including funding cuts, ideological restrictions, and efforts to control academic curricula. These measures are framed as necessary to combat 'left-wing indoctrination' and restore 'patriotic education.'

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Proposes constitutional changes to regain control over university foundations.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Overhauls college accreditation, restricts gender-affirming care, and targets 'woke' curricula.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Proposes media laws requiring journalists to disclose assets, framing them as politically exposed.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Advocates for homeschooling and opposes gender studies in schools.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Criticizes 'woke' education policies and calls for curriculum reforms.
